statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The monitoring is for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate correlation between symptoms and potential arrhythmic events
The denial reason is CO-22, indicating care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits
The diagnosis codes submitted are I34.0, R00.2, and R42
